Context: 13. Advance of T.A. on Tour

## 13. Advance of T.A. on Tour  
- Amount.(1) An amount sufficient to cover the official's personal travelling expenses for a month, viz., daily allowance, road / rail / air fares, for journeys both ways. (2) In the case of prolonged tour in the interior, to places difficult of access, an amount sufficient to cover daily·allowance, road/ rail/ air fares and contingent charges such as for the hire of conveyance, conveyance of records, tents, etc., for six weeks.
